title: Jagged Molten Filipino Mixed Peel Bicol Express
description: A spicy and savory Filipino dish featuring mixed peel and binchotan-charcoal, designed to cure hangovers with its herbal and ayurvedic properties, served in a copper mug. This Bicol Express variation is a unique and flavorful twist on the classic recipe.
instructions: Heat the coconut milk in a saucepan over medium heat until it starts to simmer.
Add the grated ginger, minced garlic, and sliced long green chili to the saucepan and stir well.
Add the diced pork shoulder to the saucepan and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the fish sauce and lime juice to the saucepan and stir well.
Add the chopped mixed peel to the saucepan and stir well.
Use the binchotan charcoal to smoke the mixture for 5 minutes.
Serve the Jagged Molten Filipino Mixed Peel Bicol Express in a copper mug.
Garnish with additional chopped mixed peel and sliced long green chili if desired.
Be careful when handling the hot copper mug.
Consider serving with a side of steamed rice to help cool down the palate.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
